title: 'Nothing to do with effort' - Trevoh Chalobah disagrees with Chelsea boss Liam Rosenior after Brighton defeat as he defends team-mates
desc: Chelsea’s season has plunged into a crisis following a demoralising 3-0 defeat at Brighton, a result that leaves the club reeling from five consecutive league losses without a single goal. The drama is now spilling over into the dressing room as Trevoh Chalobah has publicly disputed comments made by manager Liam Rosenior regarding the squad's commitment.
